segments.t: Therefore, since Christ suffered
segments.note: 「Therefore, since Christ suffered」Χριστοῦ οὖν παθόντος。「Therefore」は οὖν

segments.t: for us
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「for us」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: in the flesh,
segments.note: 「in the flesh」σαρκί

segments.t: arm yourselves also with the same mind;
segments.note: 「arm yourselves also with the same mind」καὶ ὑμεῖς ὁπλίσασθε τὴν αὐτὴν ἔννοιαν

segments.t: for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
segments.note: 「for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin」ὅτι ὁ παθὼν σαρκὶ πέπαυται ἁμαρτίας

segments.t: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh
segments.note: 「that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh」εἰς τὸ μηκέτι τὸν ἐπίλοιπον ἐν σαρκὶ βιῶσαι χρόνον。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: for the lusts of men,
segments.note: 「for the lusts of men」ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαις

segments.t: but for the will of God.
segments.note: 「but for the will of God」ἀλλὰ θελήματι θεοῦ

segments.t: For we have spent enough of our past time
segments.note: 「For we have spent enough of our past time」ὁ παρεληλυθὼς χρόνος ἀρκετὸς γάρ。WEB は主語を補う

segments.t: doing the desire of the Gentiles,
segments.note: 「doing the desire of the Gentiles」τὸ βούλημα τῶν ἐθνῶν κατειργάσθαι

segments.t: and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.
segments.note: 「and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries」πεπορευμένους ἐν ἀσελγείαις ἐπιθυμίαις οἰνοφλυγίαις κώμοις πότοις καὶ ἀθεμίτοις εἰδωλολατρίαις

segments.t: They think it is strange
segments.note: 「They think it is strange」ἐν ᾧ ξενίζονται

segments.t: that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot,
segments.note: 「that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot」μὴ συντρεχόντων ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν αὐτὴν τῆς ἀσωτίας ἀνάχυσιν。「with them」は英語の補い

segments.t: speaking evil of you.
segments.note: 「speaking evil of you」βλασφημοῦντες

segments.t: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
segments.note: 「They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead」οἳ ἀποδώσουσιν λόγον τῷ ἑτοίμως ἔχοντι κρῖναι ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς

segments.t: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead,
segments.note: 「For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead」εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ καὶ νεκροῖς εὐηγγελίσθη。「the Good News」は εὐηγγελίσθη の内部

segments.t: that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh,
segments.note: 「that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh」ἵνα κριθῶσι μὲν κατὰ ἀνθρώπους σαρκί

segments.t: but live as to God in the spirit.
segments.note: 「but live as to God in the spirit」ζῶσι δὲ κατὰ θεὸν πνεύματι

segments.t: But the end of all things is near.
segments.note: 「But the end of all things is near」Πάντων δὲ τὸ τέλος ἤγγικεν

segments.t: Therefore be of sound mind,
segments.note: 「Therefore be of sound mind」σωφρονήσατε οὖν

segments.t: self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
segments.note: 「self-controlled, and sober in prayer」καὶ νήψατε εἰς προσευχάς。「self-controlled」は英語の補い

segments.t: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves,
segments.note: 「And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves」πρὸ πάντων ἔχοντες τὴν εἰς ἑαυτοὺς ἀγάπην ἐκτενῆ。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: for love covers a multitude of sins.
segments.note: 「for love covers a multitude of sins」ὅτι ἀγάπη καλύπτει πλῆθος ἁμαρτιῶν

segments.t: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
segments.note: 「Be hospitable to one another without grumbling」φιλόξενοι εἰς ἀλλήλους ἄνευ γογγυσμοῦ。「Be」は英語の補い

segments.t: As each has received a gift,
segments.note: 「As each has received a gift」ἕκαστος καθὼς ἔλαβεν χάρισμα

segments.t: employ it in serving one another,
segments.note: 「employ it in serving one another」εἰς ἑαυτοὺς αὐτὸ διακονοῦντες

segments.t: as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
segments.note: 「as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms」ὡς καλοὶ οἰκονόμοι ποικίλης χάριτος θεοῦ。「in its various forms」は ποικίλης の表現

segments.t: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God.
segments.note: 「If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God」εἴ τις λαλεῖ ὡς λόγια θεοῦ

segments.t: If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies,
segments.note: 「If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies」εἴ τις διακονεῖ ὡς ἐξ ἰσχύος ἧς χορηγεῖ ὁ θεός

segments.t: that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ,
segments.note: 「that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ」ἵνα ἐν πᾶσιν δοξάζηται ὁ θεὸς διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ

segments.t: to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
segments.note: 「to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen」ᾧ ἐστιν ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν

segments.t: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you,
segments.note: 「Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you」Ἀγαπητοί μὴ ξενίζεσθε τῇ ἐν ὑμῖν πυρώσει πρὸς πειρασμὸν ὑμῖν γινομένῃ

segments.t: as though a strange thing happened to you.
segments.note: 「as though a strange thing happened to you」ὡς ξένου ὑμῖν συμβαίνοντος

segments.t: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice,
segments.note: 「But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice」ἀλλὰ καθὸ κοινωνεῖτε τοῖς τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθήμασιν χαίρετε

segments.t: that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
segments.note: 「that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy」ἵνα καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ χαρῆτε ἀγαλλιώμενοι

segments.t: If you are insulted for the name of Christ,
segments.note: 「If you are insulted for the name of Christ」εἰ ὀνειδίζεσθε ἐν ὀνόματι Χριστοῦ

segments.t: you are blessed,
segments.note: 「you are blessed」μακάριοι

segments.t: because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
segments.note: 「because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you」ὅτι τὸ τῆς δόξης καὶ τὸ τοῦ θεοῦ πνεῦμα ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἀναπαύεται

segments.t: On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: But let none of you suffer
segments.note: 「But let none of you suffer」μὴ γάρ τις ὑμῶν πασχέτω

segments.t: as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer,
segments.note: 「as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer」ὡς φονεὺς ἢ κλέπτης ἢ κακοποιὸς

segments.t: or a meddler in other men’s matters.
segments.note: 「or a meddler in other men’s matters」ἢ ὡς ἀλλοτριεπίσκοπος。「in other men’s matters」は ἀλλοτριεπίσκοπος のほぐし

segments.t: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian,
segments.note: 「But if one of you suffers for being a Christian」εἰ δὲ ὡς Χριστιανός。「one of you suffers」は英語の補い

segments.t: let him not be ashamed;
segments.note: 「let him not be ashamed」μὴ αἰσχυνέσθω

segments.t: but let him glorify God
segments.note: 「but let him glorify God」δοξαζέτω δὲ τὸν θεὸν

segments.t: in this matter.
segments.note: 「in this matter」ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ。WEB は ὀνόματι を「matter」と訳す

segments.t: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God.
segments.note: 「For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God」ὅτι ὁ καιρὸς τοῦ ἄρξασθαι τὸ κρίμα ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ

segments.t: If it begins first with us,
segments.note: 「If it begins first with us」εἰ δὲ πρῶτον ἀφ’ ἡμῶν

segments.t: what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?
segments.note: 「what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?」τί τὸ τέλος τῶν ἀπειθούντων τῷ τοῦ θεοῦ εὐαγγελίῳ。「will happen」は英語のほぐし

segments.t: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved,
segments.note: 「“If it is hard for the righteous to be saved」καὶ εἰ ὁ δίκαιος μόλις σῴζεται

segments.t: what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
segments.note: 「what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”」ὁ ἀσεβὴς καὶ ἁμαρτωλὸς ποῦ φανεῖται。「will happen」は φανεῖται のほぐし

segments.t: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust
segments.note: 「Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls」ὥστε καὶ οἱ πάσχοντες κατὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ παρατιθέσθωσαν τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν ἐν ἀγαθοποιΐᾳ。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
segments.note: 「to him, as to a faithful Creator」πιστῷ κτίστῃ。「to him」は英語の補い
